svg.title: FIG-12 文档 / SDK / 证据分别交付与独立恢复 每条链有独立payload与验证；公开动作以真实receipt为准 FIG-12 Separate docs / SDK / evidence recovery independent payloads, actual external receipts
svg.desc: 文档：HTML + 本地图 / 图源 文档源与软件资格输入身份 docs: HTML / local diagrams / editable DOT doc-source and software-evidence identity; Source SDK：完整安装prefix 源码 / 依赖 / 许可闭包 Source SDK: complete installed prefix source / dependencies / license closure; 软件候选与证据：同source/config/image scope reports / 原始执行日志 candidate and evidence: same source/config/image scope reports and original execution logs; delivery.package → verify payload manifest 不含自身/checksums archive hash 在外层receipt docs package / verify manifest excludes self and checksums archive hash is outside the archive; package_source_sdk.prepare / verify 源码与依赖manifest / 必需文件闭包 真实consumer通过才建立该软件scope SDK prepare / verify source manifest and required file closure actual consumers establish only their scope; candidate.py / proof.py → store.export_tree 重新验证scope proof，封存完整字节闭包 归档成功不代表重新执行历史tests candidate proof then evidence archive revalidate scope and preserve byte closure archival is not test re-execution; delivery.publish：versions/<release-id> / stable 受信任部署选择不可变文档版本 docs publish: immutable versions and stable trusted deployment selects verified version; 交付者保存不可变SDK版本包 稳定下载索引 + archive receipt delivery owner stores immutable SDK package stable download index and archive receipt; 交付者保存content-id归档 + 外层receipt 独立长期存储，不能只依赖短期CI artifact delivery owner stores content-ID and receipt independent long-term storage beyond CI; delivery.post_deploy：实际HTTP站点与下载 核对manifest / stable / payload / archive post-deploy verifies actual HTTP bytes manifest / stable / payload / archive; 独立位置实际下载完整SDK包 校验archive hash和包内路径/size/hash download complete SDK independently verify archive and member path/size/hash; store.verify_external：实际独立归档 核对archive、inventory与所有payload字节 verify actual independently stored evidence archive / inventory / all payload bytes; delivery.restore → 新根 离线HTML / anchors / 本地图 / 下载均验证 docs restore to new root verify offline HTML / anchors / images / files; 完整prefix恢复到新根 → SDK verify 独立consumer构建；Native实际运行 restore full prefix, then verify SDK build independent consumers, run Native; store.restore_tree → 新根 + 重新verify 按scope验证proof和同artifact引用 不因恢复提升HIL或产品资格 restore evidence, then revalidate bytes verify scope proof and same-artifact refs no new HIL or product qualification; 分别记录真实发布 / 下载 / 恢复结果 未发生的外部动作保留not_executed；任何失败禁止promotion record separate actual external results absent actions remain not_executed any failure prevents promotion; 文档专用payload docs-only payload; 验证通过 validated; 真实部署URL actual deployment URL; 下载的同字节包 downloaded identical package; 文档结果 doc results; SDK专用payload SDK-only payload; 该scope验证通过 validated for this scope; 实际storage位置 actual storage location; 完整prefix，不只搬source子树 full prefix, not just source subtree; SDK消费结果 SDK consumer results; 候选与完整证据closure candidate and full evidence closure; 实际proof验证通过 actual scope proof validated; 实际storage与receipt actual storage and receipt; 拒绝缺失 / 改字节 / 非法路径 reject missing / changed / unsafe paths; 归档恢复结果 evidence restoration results
